== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Squad Leader (Japanese)|Imperial Squad Leader]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157709593/TD3Sq9NCAkigHtZaj2yFOg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 90960097.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d6b8b09eda4db0975d9229fa582d4a31a596de1f19b04c2dd69726a6a47f6004</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
